Trump reignites trade dispute with Canada over tariffs

Former U.S. President Donald Trump has again raised grievances with Canada, this time focusing on retaliatory tariffs that are impacting the price of household goods like toilet paper. The situation echoes a previous shortage scare that occurred before the 2020 election. Trump's comments suggest a potential continuation of trade disputes, with his remarks indicating a stance of self-sufficiency regarding international trade relationships.
